items.title: Filtered colimits of abelian sheaves commute with cohomology under a generating set of quasi-compact sheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the commutation of cohomology with filtered colimits for a site carrying a set S of sheaves satisfying five conditions, including quasi-compactness of its members (statement lines 2629-2653). The proof is an induction on the cohomological degree with two substantial parts. The base case is reduced to the corresponding statement on colimits of global sections, whose hypotheses are checked through (1)-(3) and quasi-compactness (proof lines 2656-2675). The induction step reduces the assertion to the vanishing of H^{p0+1} on a filtered colimit of injective sheaves and computes with the Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence E_1^{p,q} = H^q(K^{p+1}, I) = H^q(C/K^{p+1}, j^{-1}I), where commutation of j^{-1} with filtered colimits and the induction hypothesis in the localized topoi give the vanishing (proof lines 2687-2725). The delicate part, which the author writes out separately, is the check that the localized topoi themselves admit a set satisfying (1)-(5), without which the induction could not be applied (proof lines 2728-2785). The claim is H2: a long but fully written-out induction.
